test_title: PYST 09: SSC Stenographer 2025: English Language & Comprehension (Held On: 08 Aug, 2025 Shift 3)
subject: english
question: Select the option that expresses the given sentence in Direct to Indirect Speech. They said, "Our teacher will explain the topic tomorrow."

options.text: They said that their teacher would explain the topic the next day.
They said that our teacher will explain the topic tomorrow.
They said that the teacher should explain the topic tomorrow.
They said that the teacher explained the topic the next day.

solution:
The correct answer is **Option 1**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• **Indirect Speech:** They said that their teacher would explain the topic the next day.
 
• **Key Conversions:**
 
 
• **"Our teacher" becomes "their teacher"**
 
 
• Possessive pronoun "our" is changed to "their&q
